messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SYNTH ALERT: 'edge-prober-eastus' failing 3/3 health checks (5m window). probe_id=ep-east-3, avg_latency=1200ms, errors=HTTP 502 x3

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident INC-89234 triggered (P1) — escalation policy: platform-sre. Link: https://pd.example/INC-89234

Maya S.: acked. I'm on it, grabbing logs from prober. Anyone watching ingress routing right now? @Aj J. @Lucas H.

Aj J.: oncall here, seeing an uptick in 502s from edge fleet in eastus in the last 6m. Not seeing higher error rates in app logs yet — maybe layer between probe and origin.

Lucas H.: checking LB health and recent deploys. No recent deploys in eastus for infra services. One control-plane restart ~10m ago but marked healthy.

Sophie P.: customer-success signal — a couple of customers in eastus reported transient timeouts to the hosted API, but no pager alerts from customers yet. CS ticket #CS-564 logged.

Maya S.: running quick curl to prober endpoint to reproduce:```bash
curl -v https://edge-prober-eastus.internal/health
```

Maya S.: response: 502 Bad Gateway, connection reset from upstream. Tracing shows service hop to 'edge-router-v2' returning 502 with backend 'inference-proxy-eu-3' marked 503 sometimes.

Aj J.: can we flip to fallback route to avoid customer impact? Runbook suggests switching prober to use mirror route for 10m while we triage.

incident-bot: Runbook step invoked by Aj J.: 'synth-fallback-route' — command queued.

Maya S.: executing fallback:```bash
kubectl -n infra apply -f /configs/prober-fallback-eastus.yaml
```

Maya S.: applied. Monitoring probe stream...

pagerduty: INC-89234 acknowledged by Aj J. at 2369990065

Sophie P.: CS: after fallback applied, two previously-opened tickets show customers saw requests complete. Notifying those customers that we're investigating.

Lucas H.: digging into edge-router-v2 logs: spikes in upstream connection timeouts to inference-proxy-eu-3 between 2369989940-2369990020. No obvious OOMs. Kernel tcp_retries? Need to check host-level.

Maya S.: running host-level checks on proxy nodes, looking for fd exhaustion and CPU steal.```bash
ssh proxy-12 "sudo ss -s; sudo cat /proc/net/netstat | grep TcpExt"
```

Maya S.: proxy-12 shows higher orphaned sockets and TIME_WAIT counts. Not full, but concurrent connections peaking due to longer backend handshake.

Aj J.: hypothesis: a TLS renegotiation bug between proxy and backend after control-plane restarts. Can we rotate proxy pods to refresh connections?

Lucas H.: agrees. Let's do rolling restart of inference-proxy-eu-3 with maxUnavailable=1. Runbook step: restart service, watch for 30s stability window.

Maya S.: initiating:```bash
kubectl -n services rollout restart deployment/inference-proxy-eu-3
kubectl -n services get pods -w -l app=inference-proxy-eu-3
```

incident-bot: Action 'restart-proxy' executed by Maya S. (step 4 of runbook)

(30s later)

Maya S.: first restarted pod back healthy, second coming up. Prober stream shows reduction in 502 spikes.

pagerduty: INC-89234: escalated to platform-sre-lead (Maya S.) due to persistent spike >10m before mitigation.

Sophie P.: CS update: reduced customer reports; still monitor for any retry storms. Sending update to affected customers: "We applied a temporary routing fallback and rotated proxy nodes. We're continuing to monitor."

Aj J.: monitoring dashboards — edge 5xx rate dropped from 3.4% -> 0.3% after restart + fallback. Latency still slightly higher (p95 ~ 520ms -> 480ms).

Maya S.: marking temporary mitigation in incident timeline. Proposed postmortem items: increase prober socket timeout, add connection pool telemetry on proxy, add automatic proxy restart if ephemeral error spike > threshold.

Lucas H.: creating infra ticket INFRA-2412 for permanent fix (increase timeouts, investigate TLS handshake patterns).

Sophie P.: CS follow-up: scheduled 1:1 with top affected customers tomorrow. Ticket numbers: CS-564, CS-565.

Aj J.: handing off to next on-call in 20m. I'll keep the PD status open until we confirm stable for 60m. Paging will be suppressed for this probe while we monitor.

oncall-rotation: next oncall (Lucas H.) acknowledged handoff. Please update channel with any regression.

Maya S.: summary for timeline: - 2369990000: prober started failing 3/3 checks - 2369990030: fallback route applied - 2369990070: restarted inference-proxy-eu-3 pods - 2369990220: metrics show stabilization - Mitigation: fallback + rolling restart.

pagerduty: INC-89234: resolved by Aj J. at 2369990380 (status: mitigated; will remain monitored).

Maya S.: adding post-incident owner: Maya S. (follow-ups INFRA-2412, adjust runbook).

Sophie P.: note for incidentreview: rate-limited customers may have observed increased retries; recommend adding a customer-facing blurb if postmortem shows impact.

Aj J.: closing thread for now, leaving monitoring active. If we see >0.5% edge 5xx in next hour, PD will re-open. :white_check_mark:
